# QMD Compilation Test

This document tests the QMD compilation environment in GitHub Codespaces.

## Code Execution Test

### Python Code

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create test data
data = {
    'Name': ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie'],
    'Age': [25, 30, 35],
    'Score': [85.5, 92.0, 78.5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
print("Python code executed successfully!")
print(df)
```

### R Code (Optional)

```{r}
# R code execution test
if (requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(dplyr)
    cat("R code executed successfully!\n")
} else {
    cat("dplyr package not available\n")
}
```

## Plot Test

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a simple plot
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
y = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
plt.plot(x, y, marker='o')
plt.title('Test Plot')
plt.xlabel('X values')
plt.ylabel('Y values')
plt.show()
```

## Compilation Instructions

To compile this document:

```bash
quarto render test.qmd
```

The output will be an HTML file: `test.html`
